title: 扩散到压缩：利用扩散语言模型实现无损压缩
summary: 本文首次将扩散语言模型（DLM）用于无损文本压缩，以解决自回归LLM压缩方法吞吐量低的问题。通过设计高效策略应对DLM在压缩中的算法挑战，在enwik8基准上超越了现有LLM和通用压缩器，推动了无损压缩技术发展。
summary_en: This paper introduces Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) for lossless text compression, addressing the throughput bottleneck of autoregressive LLM-based methods. By designing efficient strategies, it achieves state-of-the-art results on enwik8, surpassing LLM-based and general-purpose compressors.
